---
title: "International Electronics Retailer Dashboard"
format:
  dashboard:
    scrolling: true
    theme: cosmo
    include-in-header: header_qmd.html
params:
  data_path: "International_Electronics_Retailer_2.xlsx"
  dict_path: "Data_Dictionary.xlsx"
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
---

```{r}
#| include: false
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# Packages: flexdashboard, readxl, dplyr, tidyr, lubridate, plotly, DT, scales
# install.packages(c("flexdashboard","readxl","dplyr","tidyr",
#                    "lubridate","plotly","DT","scales","quarto"))
# Run: click Render in RStudio, or quarto::quarto_render("electronics_dashboard_en.qmd")
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
library(flexdashboard)
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(scales)

# ---- Colors (blue as the main hue; series colors in a fixed order) ----
BLUE   <- "#2a78d6"; ORANGE <- "#eb6834"; AQUA <- "#1baf7a"
INK2   <- "#52514e"; GRID <- "#ebeae6"
FONT   <- "'Noto Sans TC', 'PingFang TC', 'Microsoft JhengHei', sans-serif"
SEQ    <- c("#cde2fb", "#86b6ef", "#3987e5", "#256abf", "#104281")

# ---- Load and clean the data ----
raw <- read_excel(params$data_path)
names(raw) <- c("order_no","line_item","order_date","delivery_date","customer",
                "store","product","qty","currency","gender","name","city",
                "state_code","cust_state","zip","cust_country","continent",
                "birthday","store_country","store_state","sqm","open_date",
                "product_name","brand","color","unit_cost","unit_price",
                "subcat_key","subcategory","cat_key","category","exchange",
                "unit_price_local")

# Some text in the source file has unreadable characters (U+FFFD); replace them with "?"
raw <- raw %>% mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ gsub("\uFFFD", "?", .x, fixed = TRUE)))

# ---- **Data repair**: in 595 rows a corrupted character in the name shifted customer fields one column right ----
# Signs: Customer Country holds a continent (North America / Europe), Birthday is blank,
# and the birthday text sits in Continent. Shift the fields back to the left.
shifted <- raw$cust_country %in% c("North America", "Europe")
n_shifted <- sum(shifted); n_shift_cust <- n_distinct(raw$customer[shifted])
raw <- raw %>% mutate(
  birthday     = if_else(shifted, as.POSIXct(mdy(continent)), birthday),
  continent    = if_else(shifted, cust_country, continent),
  cust_country = if_else(shifted, zip, cust_country),
  zip          = if_else(shifted, cust_state, zip),
  cust_state   = if_else(shifted, state_code, cust_state),
  state_code   = if_else(shifted, city, state_code),
  city         = if_else(shifted, NA_character_, city))

# Display labels
cat_lbl <- c("Computers" = "Computers", "Cell phones" = "Cell Phones",
            "Music, Movies and Audio Books" = "Music, Movies & Audio Books",
            "Audio" = "Audio", "Games and Toys" = "Games & Toys",
            "Home Appliances" = "Home Appliances",
            "Cameras and camcorders" = "Cameras & Camcorders",
            "TV and Video" = "TV & Video")
ctry_lbl <- c("United States" = "United States", "Online" = "Online Store",
             "United Kingdom" = "United Kingdom", "Germany" = "Germany",
             "Canada" = "Canada", "Australia" = "Australia",
             "Italy" = "Italy", "Netherlands" = "Netherlands",
             "France" = "France")
CH_ON <- "Online"; CH_ST <- "In-store"

d <- raw %>%
  mutate(order_date    = as.Date(order_date),
         delivery_date = as.Date(delivery_date),
         birthday      = as.Date(birthday),
         revenue  = qty * unit_price,          # Revenue (USD)
         cost     = qty * unit_cost,           # Cost (USD)
         profit   = revenue - cost,            # Gross profit (USD)
         year     = year(order_date),
         month    = floor_date(order_date, "month"),
         age      = floor(time_length(interval(birthday, order_date), "years")),
         age_grp  = cut(age, c(0, 25, 35, 45, 55, 65, 75, 120), right = FALSE,
                        labels = c("<25", "25–34", "35–44", "45–54", "55–64", "65–74", "75+")),
         channel  = if_else(store_country == "Online", CH_ON, CH_ST),
         cat_lbl   = recode(category, !!!cat_lbl),
         store_ctry_lbl = recode(store_country, !!!ctry_lbl),
         cust_ctry_lbl  = recode(cust_country, !!!ctry_lbl),
         gender_lbl = recode(gender, Male = "Male", Female = "Female"),
         ship_days = as.numeric(delivery_date - order_date))

last_day   <- max(d$order_date)
full_years <- d %>% filter(year < year(last_day))
last_full  <- max(full_years$year)

# ---- Shared formatting ----
usd_m <- function(x) paste0("$", formatC(x / 1e6, format = "f", digits = 2), "M")
usd   <- function(x) dollar(x, accuracy = 1)
pct   <- function(x, d = 1) percent(x, accuracy = 10^-d)

style <- function(p, x = "", y = "", yfmt = NULL, xfmt = NULL, legend = FALSE) {
  p %>% layout(
    font = list(family = FONT, color = INK2, size = 12),
    paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
    xaxis = list(title = x, gridcolor = GRID, zeroline = FALSE, tickformat = xfmt,
                 automargin = TRUE),
    yaxis = list(title = y, gridcolor = GRID, zeroline = FALSE, tickformat = yfmt,
                 automargin = TRUE),
    showlegend = legend,
    legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = 1.12),
    margin = list(l = 8, r = 16, t = 8, b = 8),
    hoverlabel = list(font = list(family = FONT)),
    bargap = 0.35
  ) %>% config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}

hbar <- function(df, cat, val, text, color = BLUE, xfmt = "$~s") {
  # cat / val are column names (strings); sort ascending so the largest bar is on top
  df <- df[order(df[[val]]), ]
  df$.y <- factor(df[[cat]], levels = df[[cat]])
  df$.x <- df[[val]]
  plot_ly(df, y = ~.y, x = ~.x, type = "bar", orientation = "h", text = text,
          hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>", textposition = "none",
          marker = list(color = color)) %>%
    style(xfmt = xfmt)
}

# ---- Headline metrics ----
tot_rev    <- sum(d$revenue)
tot_profit <- sum(d$profit)
n_orders   <- n_distinct(d$order_no)
n_cust     <- n_distinct(d$customer)
yr <- full_years %>% group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(revenue = sum(revenue), profit = sum(profit),
            orders = n_distinct(order_no), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(yoy = revenue / lag(revenue) - 1)
peak <- yr %>% slice_max(revenue, n = 1)
cat_tot   <- d %>% count(cat_lbl, wt = revenue) %>% mutate(s = n / sum(n))
top_cat   <- cat_tot$cat_lbl[which.max(cat_tot$n)]
top_share <- max(cat_tot$s)
online_share <- sum(d$revenue[d$channel == CH_ON]) / tot_rev
```



```{r}

```

```{r}
list(icon = "receipt", color = "light", value = comma(n_orders))
```



## Row {height=460px}

### Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| title: "Monthly Revenue & Gross Profit (USD)"
m <- d %>% filter(month < floor_date(last_day, "month")) %>%   # drop the partial last month
  group_by(month) %>%
  summarise(revenue = sum(revenue), profit = sum(profit), .groups = "drop")
plot_ly(m, x = ~month) %>%
  add_lines(y = ~revenue, name = "Revenue", line = list(color = BLUE, width = 2),
            hovertemplate = "%{x|%Y-%m}<br>Revenue %{y:$,.0f}<extra></extra>") %>%
  add_lines(y = ~profit, name = "Gross Profit", line = list(color = ORANGE, width = 2),
            hovertemplate = "%{x|%Y-%m}<br>Gross Profit %{y:$,.0f}<extra></extra>") %>%
  style(yfmt = "$~s", legend = TRUE) %>%
  layout(hovermode = "x unified", xaxis = list(tickformat = "%Y"))
```

### Column {width=40%}

::: {.card title="Key Insights"}
<div class="insight">

- **`r peak$year` was the peak year**: revenue of `r usd_m(peak$revenue)`, up `r pct(peak$yoy)` year over year.
- **`r last_full` revenue fell `r pct(-yr$yoy[yr$year == last_full])`** to `r usd_m(yr$revenue[yr$year == last_full])`, the only full year of decline.
- Overall gross margin is **`r pct(tot_profit / tot_rev)`**; the largest category is **`r top_cat`** at `r pct(top_share)` of revenue.
- **Online** accounts for **`r pct(online_share)`** of revenue; among physical stores, the United States contributes the most.
- Data covers `r format(min(d$order_date))` to `r format(last_day)`; the partial month `r format(last_day, "%Y-%m")` is excluded from the trend chart.

</div>
:::

```{r}
#| title: "Annual Revenue (Full Years)"
plot_ly(yr, x = ~factor(year), y = ~revenue, type = "bar",
        marker = list(color = BLUE),
        text = ~usd_m(revenue), textposition = "outside",
        textfont = list(size = 11, color = INK2), cliponaxis = FALSE,
        hovertext = ~paste0(year, "<br>Revenue ", usd_m(revenue),
                            ifelse(is.na(yoy), "", paste0("<br>YoY ", pct(yoy)))),
        hovertemplate = "%{hovertext}<extra></extra>") %>%
  style(yfmt = "$~s")
```

```{r}
#| title: "Revenue by Category"
cat_s <- d %>% group_by(cat_lbl) %>%
  summarise(revenue = sum(revenue), profit = sum(profit), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(margin = profit / revenue, share = revenue / sum(revenue))
hbar(cat_s, "cat_lbl", "revenue",
     text = ~paste0(cat_lbl, "<br>Revenue ", usd_m(revenue), " (", pct(share), ")",
                    "<br>Margin ", pct(margin)))
```

# Products

## Row {height=440px}

```{r}
#| title: "Revenue Heatmap: Category × Year (USD)"
hm <- full_years %>% group_by(cat_lbl, year) %>%
  summarise(revenue = sum(revenue), .groups = "drop")
ord <- hm %>% count(cat_lbl, wt = revenue) %>% arrange(n) %>% pull(cat_lbl)
plot_ly(hm, x = ~factor(year), y = ~factor(cat_lbl, levels = ord), z = ~revenue,
        type = "heatmap", colors = SEQ, xgap = 2, ygap = 2,
        text = ~paste0(cat_lbl, " · ", year, "<br>Revenue ", usd_m(revenue)),
        hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>",
        colorbar = list(title = "", tickformat = "$~s", thickness = 10)) %>%
  style()
```

```{r}
#| title: "Top 10 Products by Revenue"
top_p <- d %>% group_by(product_name, cat_lbl) %>%
  summarise(revenue = sum(revenue), qty = sum(qty), profit = sum(profit),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  slice_max(revenue, n = 10)
hbar(top_p, "product_name", "revenue",
     text = ~paste0(product_name, "<br>", cat_lbl, "<br>Revenue ", usd(revenue),
                    "<br>Units ", comma(qty), "<br>Margin ", pct(profit / revenue)))
```

## Row {height=440px}

```{r}
#| title: "Revenue & Margin by Brand"
br <- d %>% group_by(brand) %>%
  summarise(revenue = sum(revenue), profit = sum(profit), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(margin = profit / revenue)
hbar(br, "brand", "revenue",
     text = ~paste0(brand, "<br>Revenue ", usd_m(revenue), "<br>Margin ", pct(margin)))
```

## Row {height=560px}

```{r}
#| title: "Subcategory Detail"
d %>% group_by(cat_lbl, subcategory) %>%
  summarise(revenue = sum(revenue), profit = sum(profit), qty = sum(qty),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(margin = profit / revenue) %>% arrange(desc(revenue)) %>%
  datatable(rownames = FALSE, fillContainer = TRUE,
            colnames = c("Category", "Subcategory", "Revenue",
                         "Gross Profit", "Units", "Margin"),
            options = list(pageLength = 10, dom = "ftp", scrollX = TRUE)) %>%

```

# Markets & Channels

## Row {height=440px}

```{r}
#| title: "Revenue by Store Country"
sc <- d %>% group_by(store_ctry_lbl) %>%
  summarise(revenue = sum(revenue), orders = n_distinct(order_no),
            stores = n_distinct(store), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(share = revenue / sum(revenue))
hbar(sc, "store_ctry_lbl", "revenue",
     text = ~paste0(store_ctry_lbl, "<br>Revenue ", usd_m(revenue), " (", pct(share), ")",
                    "<br>Orders ", comma(orders), "<br>Stores ", stores))
```

```{r}
#| title: "Online vs. In-store Revenue Share"
ch <- full_years %>% group_by(year, channel) %>%
  summarise(revenue = sum(revenue), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(year) %>% mutate(share = revenue / sum(revenue)) %>% ungroup()
plot_ly(ch, x = ~factor(year), y = ~share, color = ~channel,
        colors = setNames(c(ORANGE, BLUE), c(CH_ON, CH_ST)), type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines+markers", line = list(width = 2), marker = list(size = 8),
        text = ~paste0(year, " · ", channel, "<br>Share ", pct(share),
                       "<br>Revenue ", usd_m(revenue)),
        hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>") %>%
  style(yfmt = ".0%", legend = TRUE) %>%
  layout(yaxis = list(range = c(0, 1)))
```

```{r}
#| title: "Top 15 Stores by Revenue per m²"

  group_by(store, store_ctry_lbl, store_state, sqm) %>%

```

```{r}

plot_ly(st_all, x = ~sqm, y = ~revenue, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
```
